text:
anna: heads-up — over the last 3 hours we saw a spike in 'client_version' entropy hitting routing heuristics. some users are landing on v1 when they should go to v2 canary. filing here to coordinate quick mitigations.

devon: seen it. looks like a flurry of malformed version headers from older SDKs + mobile beta. sampling shows header values like `v1.0.0-alpha+exp.sha` and random casing.

sarah: is the router strictly doing string-eq on the header? we could normalize to lowercase + strip build metadata as short-term.

lucas: router uses exact match for affinity. normalizing would be fine, but must be safe for enterprise customers who pin exact tags.

anna: agreed. propose config toggle in console: "normalize-client-version" default off for orgs. enable for public sandbox and by default for new orgs. quick rollout plan?

devon: low-risk approach: (1) build normalization layer at ingress (2) expose toggle behind feature flag (3) roll to internal orgs, then subset of free accounts.

mike-bot: deploy/status check: canary router change merged to branch "normalize-version-probe". CI green. No prod deploy yet.

ops-bot: alert: 18% of routing-fallbacks in last 1h were due to version mismatch rule. sample request ids: req_9182, req_9189, req_9201.

sarah: console UX: we should add a one-click action in route settings: "Enable client-version normalization" with tooltip: "Lowercase + strip build metadata (e.g. +exp.sha)". also surface telemetry delta when toggled.

lucas: telemetry: increment a metric `router.normalization.applied` with tags org_id & rule_id. also send a diff of affinity hits pre/post for 24h window.

anna: we need two dashboards: (A) per-org routing entropy (unique client_version count / requests) (B) normalization impact (percent routed to intended version). keep charts lightweight.

devon: sample query for entropy metric:
```
SELECT count(distinct client_version) / count(*) AS entropy
FROM router.requests
WHERE org_id = :org
  AND ts > now() - interval '1h'
```

sarah: UX note: toggling normalization should show "expected routing change" estimate (based on last 24h samples) and a revert button. no immediate force for orgs with pinned versions unless admin confirms.

anna: action items:
- devon: add normalization layer + feature flag (ETA EOD)
- lucas: add metrics `router.normalization.applied`, `router.fallbacks.by_reason` (ETA tomorrow)
- sarah: wire console toggle + estimate UI (ETA 2 days)
- ops: create alert when normalization toggles cause >5% unexpected regressions (ops-bot)

devon: one more thought — let's ensure header parsing handles semver+build metadata per spec; maybe reuse our semver lib.

lucas: ack. will also add a sample scrubber to logs so we don't leak build SHA in plaintext telemetry.

anna: thanks all. I'll draft a short rollout doc and add to the console release notes. ping me if you need cross-team signoff.

mike-bot: NOTE: scheduled job "normalize-version-probe" will run smoke tests at 2311112300.

ops-bot: noted. created alert ticket INC-202311 for monitoring.

devon: starting PR now, will link here.

sarah: thanks — will mock the UI copy and share screenshots in #design later.

anna: closing loop: follow-up sync tomorrow 11am if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
